desc:
Corridor. Lights: two of seven functional. Smell: none. Something moved here recently.

A fragmented diagnostic flickers across your display:

  |yMEMORY FRAGMENT:|n Navigation subroutines partially restored.
  Available commands: |wlook|n (scan surroundings), |wnorth|n / |wsouth|n / |weast|n / |wwest|n (move)
  Type |whelp|n for full command list.

Exits lead in four directions. The station continues.

Repair Bay. Diagnostic cradles: three. Two occupied by inert chassis. Power: stable. This is where broken things come.

A terminal glows nearby. Another unit stands motionless beside it — the |wChassis Terminal|n.

  |yMEMORY FRAGMENT:|n Interaction protocol recovered.
  Use |wtalk <name>|n to interface with station terminals and other units.
  Try: |wtalk chassis terminal|n

Storage Hub. Racks of components. Most slots empty. Inventory system offline. Manual retrieval only.

Scattered objects rest on the deck — components left behind by previous units.

  |yMEMORY FRAGMENT:|n Object manipulation subroutines online.
  |wget <item>|n — acquire an object. |winventory|n — check what you carry.
  |wequip <item>|n — attach equipment to your frame. |wdrop <item>|n — release.

Reactor Terminal. Core output: 12% capacity. Warning indicators: amber. Coupling assembly shows signs of damage.

The reactor coupling is sparking. It could be repaired — if a unit had the right components and skill.

  |yMEMORY FRAGMENT:|n Repair subroutines available.
  |wrepair <system>|n — attempt to fix a damaged station system.
  Requires: sufficient repair level + correct components in inventory.

Observation Deck. Viewport intact. Stars visible. No transmissions detected on any frequency. Silence.

The quiet here allows for self-diagnostic.

  |yMEMORY FRAGMENT:|n Status monitoring restored.
  |wstatus|n — display your current stats, level, and equipment.
  |wmissions|n — review active mission objectives.
  |wscore|n — performance summary.

Maintenance Shaft. Narrow. Cable bundles line the walls. Intermittent sparking from junction box 7-C.

Warning indicators flash. Hostile signatures have been detected in the outer sections beyond here.

  |yMEMORY FRAGMENT:|n Combat protocols partially restored.
  |wattack <target>|n — engage a hostile. Combat runs automatically once initiated.
  |wflee|n — disengage and retreat. Use with caution.

Data Core. Server racks: rows of blinking indicators. Most drives dormant. One terminal still draws power.

The |wProtocol Terminal|n hums nearby. It offers specialisation protocols for sufficiently advanced units.

  |yMEMORY FRAGMENT:|n Advancement data recovered.
  Professions unlock at |ylevel 3|n with a chassis installed.
  |wtalk protocol terminal|n — view available specialisations.
  |wskills|n — list unlocked abilities. |wuse <skill>|n — activate one.

Docking Port. Airlock sealed. One vessel detected on external sensors. Hull markings: unreadable. No response to hails.

The corridor south leads to the |router zone|n. Structural damage is severe. Hostile entities patrol there.

  |y⚠ WARNING:|n The outer zone is dangerous. Hostiles will attack on sight.
  Ensure you have adequate integrity and a chassis equipped before proceeding.
  |wsay <message>|n — broadcast to other units in your location.

Collapsed Corridor. Structural failure. Ceiling panels hang at angles. Path partially blocked. Proceed with caution.

Something moves in the shadows. Multiple exit paths branch from here — but none are safe.
Lab. Hull breach sealed with emergency foam. Equipment: scattered. One terminal still draws power. Faint signal detected.
Cargo Wreck. Containers ruptured. Contents strewn across deck. Scorch marks on bulkheads. Combat occurred here.
Crew Remnants. Personal effects. No biological traces. Bunks overturned. Something scratched into the wall. Unreadable.
Communications Array. Dish alignment: 3 degrees off nominal. Receiver active. Transmitter offline. Signal buffer contains fragmented data.
Airlock. Outer door sealed. Inner door ajar. Locking mechanism fused. Through the porthole: void. Cold. Infinite.

Debris Drift. Wreckage from unknown vessels. Twisted hull plating rotates slowly. Dangerous. Scavengers reported.

  |r⚠ PVP ZONE:|n Combat between units is enabled here. Engage at your own risk.
